The dMAT becomes part of the APS documentation for applications relating to the summer semester 2027 intake and subsequent intakes, unless an exemption applies.

Current schedule

  • 29 June 2026 – Registration starts
  • 15 September 2026 – Registration deadline
  • 26 September 2026 – dMAT test date
  • 12 October 2026 – Certificate available online via the test takers’ portal of g.a.s.t.

Test centers

The test will be offered in selected cities in India.

Document history

29 June 2026
Initial publication of the dMAT information page for selected Master’s applicants in India.
30 June 2026
Clarification of transitional rules for applicants who completed APS online registration or shipped APS application documents before 29 June 2026.
13 July 2026
Clarification that applicants subject to the dMAT requirement may submit their APS application documents before the dMAT certificate is available.
